title: First Word
desc: "Dada." Clear as a bell, looking right at him. Dad didn't speak for a full minute.
story: We were having breakfast and Dad was making you laugh by tapping the table, when you looked at him very deliberately and said 'Dada.' No ambiguity. No could-have-been-anything. Just 'Dada,' clear and certain. Dad immediately said it didn't count. Mum has a video. It counts.
